title: A mail message owns its sent date across setters, getters and copies
summary: Ordinary message copies now retain the original 1234 ms through mutations of the input, getter and target. Both copy paths skipped a subclass's getter-provided date.

change.description: `SimpleMailMessage` clones a non-null `Date` on input, output, construction from another message, and transfer to a `MailMessage`. The copy paths also change how they read the original date.

notes: The subclass leaves the inherited field unset. Its getter still returned 1234. The constructed copy returned null and the pre-populated target retained 77.
